items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Lorraine said you referred to him as the 'tonsil doctor'?

ctx.x: Yeah, well--tonsillectomy, out of respect for my father, to actually let him know he was a part of my thoughts in my music somewhere, so I titled it 'Tonsillectomy'.
Lorraine said you referred to him as the 'tonsil doctor'?
